data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate's gross prior-year claims development in 2017 was strongly favourable, with aggregate releases from pre-2016 underwriting years of approximately GBP 524.2m (a c.70.5% reduction versus opening gross claims outstanding of GBP 743.4m) as calculated from the gross claims development table. This favourable development was partially offset within the year by significant 2017 catastrophe losses (Hurricanes Harvey, Irma, Maria and Californian wildfires) and by reserve strengthening driven by the reduction in the UK Personal Injury Discount Rate which affected EL/PL, international casualty and motor exposures. Some treaty business experienced favourable development and releases, while EL/PL and certain casualty/motor classes required strengthening.
raw_causal_phrases: The 2017 result for Syndicate 435 was impacted by the significant catastrophe events in the year as well as the change to the UK Personal Injury Discount Rate.
Hurricanes Harvey, Irma and Maria as well as the Californian wildfires gave rise to material losses which were within modelled expectations.
Although the Property team generated a loss in the year it was tempered by favourable development and releases from prior year reserves for the treaty business.
This book has performed well and it has again been possible to release reserves from prior years.
The reserves have been subject to a detailed review following the reduction in the UK Personal Injury Discount Rate and, as a consequence, some strengthening was required.
The International Casualty and Motor books were also impacted by the reduction in the UK Personal Injury Discount Rate resulting in an increase in the reserves.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development (PYD) gross figure was not stated in a dedicated 'movement in prior years' note; PYD was calculated from the gross claims development triangle (page 34) excluding the '2010 and prior' aggregate column and excluding the two most recent underwriting years (2016 and 2017) per the prescribed method. The result is a large gross release (-GBP 524.212m). Narrative references to net releases exist but no gross prior-year movement line was found. The balance sheet and technical-provisions LOB breakdowns include current-year catastrophe impacts and reinsurance effects which can distort LOB-level movements; no RITC was identified.
